findings.claim: The learning window is the score-clock interval [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing; the curve support audit reports [0.0, 0.49], so any temporal statement is bounded to this window and no extrapolation is licensed.
The task objective is final predicted target affinity primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; coordinate contrasts are therefore proxies, not affinity measurements.

For landmark_00, the continuous-trend table reports no accepted polynomial for any of the ten local features (polynomial_accepted=false throughout), with relative_node_RMSE between roughly 0.29 and 0.87 and multiple sign changes (4 to 10) plus strong sign conflicts (1 to 14) per feature.

Landmark_00 rate contrasts are large and sign-reversing between window ends: e.g. landmark_00_local_dy first_rate_z=-72.37 and last_rate_z=+5.52, landmark_00_local_cxy first_rate_z=+64.83 and last_rate_z=-19.67, landmark_00_local_dx first_rate_z=-17.49 and last_rate_z=+8.11, landmark_00_local_cyy first_rate_z=-36.49 and last_rate_z=+17.14. These are changing contrasts, not an absolute coordinate target.

Whole-window mean z for landmark_00 features is small relative to the endpoint rate z values (e.g. landmark_00_soft_mass whole_window_z=0.64, landmark_00_local_cxx whole_window_z=-0.58, landmark_00_local_cyy whole_window_z=-0.58), indicating the net displacement over the window is weak even where instantaneous rates are large.

hypotheses.direction: test whether early-window observed-forecast relevance and late-window static relevance differ, without reversing the affinity objective
hypotheses.falsifier: if the landmark_00 rate contrasts are statistically indistinguishable across early and late sub-windows at fixed dose, or if the sign-change count collapses under batch resampling, the stage-dependent relevance hypothesis is not supported
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00 local coordinate features (e.g. local_dy, local_cxy, local_dx, local_cyy) over score nodes 0.0-0.49
hypotheses.scope: landmark_00 region, all seeds in the supplied learning window
hypotheses.statement: Landmark_00 local coordinate contrasts change direction within the observed window rather than following a single monotone trend, so a stage-dependent (time-varying) relevance of the endpoint teacher cloud is a plausible object of test at fixed dose, while a single fixed absolute coordinate target is not supported.

hypotheses.direction: prefer gradual change over a reproducible knot
hypotheses.falsifier: an independently stable profile with a reproducible knot would contradict the gradual-change default
hypotheses.observable: polynomial_accepted, relative_node_RMSE, sign_changes and strong_sign_conflicts for landmark_00 features
hypotheses.statement: Because no landmark_00 polynomial is accepted and strong sign conflicts are present, a smooth gradual blend (no data-derived knot) is the appropriate default rather than a sharp stage boundary.

limitations: Stage profiles and temporal profiles are reported unavailable; only continuous curves and summary tables were inspected, so no stage-resolved claim is made.
Only landmark_00 continuous-trend rows were read; other landmarks were not queried and remain unobserved rather than absent.
Coordinate contrasts are untyped geometric proxies; no energy, strain or chemical-interaction interpretation is attached to them.
Selection preference and survival are not evidence of final affinity improvement; no decoded final-affinity labels were available in this role input.
